name: dry-run
note:
Dry run of the whole pipeline with the offline fake client. Writes to its own MongoDB
database, monosplit_dry_run, which is never dumped: its numbers are not experimental data.
It reads the JPetStore graph from the main database.

The dry run also rehearses the hypothesis tests of the full experiment, on the fake
client's numbers. They test the code path only; the pilot itself is descriptive.
